data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 Bulgaria factsheet summarizes how 15-year-old students in Bulgaria performed in mathematics, reading, and science, and how results changed over time (notably compared with 2018 and 2012). It reports mean performance trends, proficiency-level distributions (e.g., shares at Level 2+, Level 5/6), and gaps by socio-economic status and gender, using OECD PISA 2022 Database tables. For Bulgaria, 6,107 students in 202 schools completed the assessment in mathematics, reading or science, representing about 80% of the estimated 15-year-old population. The factsheet also highlights that PISA 2022 was delayed to 2022 due to COVID-19 and notes that Bulgaria met PISA quality standards for reporting.
